items.html: And behold, the two Mochin called Chochma-Bina of the Tzelem of Ima are concealed within the Netzach-Hod of Tevuna, and likewise the Chochma-Bina of the Tzelem of Aba are concealed within the Netzach-Hod of Aba. However, Daat is within the phase of the Yesod of Aba and Ima, and therefore it is revealed and goes out from there in the secret of the Chassadim, which go out from there and spread within ZA, and enlarge him, and they also enlarge the two concealed Mochin, which are Chochma-Bina.
